column1: # The bytes whose change can invalidate a result row in this trap's log. The
# fingerprint over these files is what a row records instead of a commit SHA:
# a SHA identifies a history that rebasing rewrites, a content fingerprint
# identifies the bytes that were actually measured and survives the rewrite.
# Deliberately over-inclusive rather than minimal. A missing path produces a
# row that claims to still be valid when it is not; an extra path only produces
# a stale warning someone has to look at.
